meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写并验证 seek-safe 的关键帧动画：选定要动的物体和状态，选最小机制（GSAP/CSS/Anime 等），同步构建时间线，再用 lint、keyframes 命令和快照验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要 seek-safe 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧等，或要求运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发。

say.text: 给这个合成添加 seek-safe 关键帧，让方块从 A 平移到 B。
say.note: Claude 会编写并验证关键帧时间线。

say.text: 在 GSAP 时间线里给标题加旋转和透明度渐入。
say.note: 会同步注册到 HyperFrames 运行时。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 检查这个合成的关键帧。
say.note: 会输出诊断结果并修复问题。

howto.what_en: Claude writes and verifies seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames: picks subject/states, chooses the minimal mechanism, builds synchronous timelines, and validates via lint, keyframes, and snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, etc., or asks for `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Add seek-safe keyframes moving the box from A to B.
say_en.note: Claude will author and verify the timeline.

say_en.text: In the GSAP timeline, rotate the title and fade it in.
Run hyperframes keyframes diagnostics on this composition.
say_en.note: It reports issues and fixes them.
